title: document.title
containerWidth: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.container'); return c ? Math.round(c.getBoundingClientRect().width) : null; })()
gutterX: (() => { const r = document.createElement('div'); r.className = 'row'; document.body.appendChild(r); const v = getComputedStyle(r).getPropertyValue('--bs-gutter-x').trim(); r.remove(); return v; })()
iconMissingGlyph: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('i[class*="fa-"]')).filter(e => { const c = getComputedStyle(e, '::before').content; return !c || c === 'none' || c === 'normal'; }).map(e => e.className)
